- Get quotes from 3-5 companies to compare

**What to look for:**
- Licensed and insured
- Positive recent reviews (not just old ones)
- Transparent pricing with written estimates
- Local experience with Pleasanton moves

- Local, independent movers (often more personalized)
- Larger regional companies with Pleasanton service areas
- Check if they're members of professional moving associations

**Red flags to avoid:**
- Pressure to pay upfront
- Vague pricing
- No verifiable reviews
- Unlicensed operators
